div.span:
.NET 10 isolated · scales to zero · max 40 instances
HTTP /api/*: REST for the web app (Board.Post on every route)
MCP /runtime/webhooks/mcp: 14 tools, Entra bearer per call
Action broker: policy → human approval → execute
Enrichment: advanced hunting + entity lookups (read-only)
Timers: incident poller (1 min) · stuck-action recovery
built-in auth on: strips forged principal headers
migrations applied at start-up · identity: blueboard-id-api

div.div:
1 Analysts → Static Web App: HTTPS, Entra sign-in (built-in auth)
2 Static Web App → Function App /api/*: linked backend,
signed-in principal forwarded by the platform
3 Agents → MCP /runtime/webhooks/mcp with an Entra bearer token,
validated and role-checked on every tool call
4 Function App → PostgreSQL: TLS, Entra token as the password
5 Read: incident poller, advanced hunting, entity lookups
6 Write: containment only after policy + human approval
7 Reference agent → Foundry Messages API with an Entra token
The Function App reaches storage and Application Insights with its
managed identity; no shared keys or connection secrets.
Agents hold no Microsoft security permissions. No hop uses a stored secret.
